title: Check the demo files
setup:
cat > check.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# Checks that each note has content. It waits before each result.
count=0
for file in notes/*.md; do
  printf 'Check %s ' "$file"
  sleep 0.8
  if test -s "$file"; then
    printf '\033[32mok\033[0m\n'
  else
    printf '\033[33mempty\033[0m\n'
  fi
  count=$((count + 1))
done
sleep 0.5
printf '\033[1m%s files checked.\033[0m\n' "$count"
EOF
